title: understudy.benchmark_flag.v1
description: One human quality flag against a benchmark or one of its tasks. Stored as one JSON object per line in a flags.jsonl file next to the benchmark's manifest (benchmark.json). Viewers surface open flags everywhere the flagged unit appears and let leaderboards exclude flagged tasks. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this flag shape.

benchmark_id.description: benchmark_id of the manifest this flag belongs to.

task_id.description: Task the flag targets. Null flags the whole benchmark.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the flag was recorded.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only open flags affect leaderboard exclusion.
